newsitem.title: CANADA: Corriente up on acquisition news.
newsitem.headline: Corriente up on acquisition news.

text.p: Shares in Vancouver-based Corriente Resources Inc bounded upward Tuesday in heavy trading after the company released details of an acquisition in Argentina.
The stock was up C$0.90 to C$4.65 in mid-afternoon trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange. More than half a million shares had traded hands.
Corriente said it had acquired 60,000 hectares of claims in the copper-gold belt in Salta province in northwestern Argentina.
The claims are next to a property held by Mansfield Minerals Inc, the company said.
Mansfield, in a joint venture with Teck Corp, has just completed a major program of surface trenching of newly discovered mineralized zones, Corriente said.
Investor excitement about the Mansfield property has spread over to Corriente, sparking a buying spree, one analyst said. Investors generally are keen on exploration in Argentina, he added.
